description: Capture AFTER evidence proving the WS4 acceptance criteria and write the walkthrough the orchestrator needs for the PR description. Uses the FEAT-001 harness against the FEAT-002 build. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Run the viewport harness for all five routes at BOTH 390x844 and 1280x900 against the built out/, writing PNG + JSON under docs/a11y/after-*. Confirm every JSON reports noHorizontalScroll:true (scrollWidth<=innerWidth) at both widths.

Capture reduced-motion evidence: run the harness (or a small variant) once with the emulated media feature prefers-reduced-motion=reduce and once with no-preference, on at least one 3D demo and the landing page, saving before/after-style stills under docs/a11y/ that show ambient/idle motion and CSS animations damped when reduced motion is on. Playwright supports context/page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion:'reduce' }); wire that into the harness via a flag. If deterministic stills cannot show the difference, additionally document the code paths gated and cite that emulateMedia toggled the hook.

Write docs/a11y/AFTER.md containing: the machine/runtime + browser; a per-route table of scrollWidth vs innerWidth at both widths (all <= width); the meaningful aria-label text for each of the four canvases; how prefers-reduced-motion is wired (the shared hook + the CSS media query) and exactly what it disables/damps (camera nudges, ambient particles, avatar idle bob/sway, wardrobe autoRotate, landing CSS animations) with confirmation motion returns when off; and confirmation WS1/WS2/WS3 wins are preserved and HOW verified.

Write docs/a11y/KEYBOARD.md: the end-to-end keyboard-path walkthrough PER WIDGET (chef, coach: composer input -> chips -> Send, plus mute + QualityToggle; pet: Feed/Play/Sleep/Clean -> name input -> Save, plus QualityToggle; wardrobe: option cards -> swatches -> custom-colour -> animation radios, plus QualityToggle), noting the visible focus indicator and, for the WS3 clickable props, the keyboard/AT-reachable equivalent (chef 'Suggest a recipe' chip, pet 'Play' button, wardrobe option cards).
Optionally write docs/a11y/DIFF.md summarizing before vs after per route (scroll fixed, panel no longer covering canvas). List all files changed in the workstream.

Commit the docs/a11y AFTER evidence + markdown (and any harness tweak needed for emulateMedia). Do NOT commit node_modules/, .next/, out/, or assets-src/. Message like `docs(a11y): WS4 AFTER evidence, keyboard walkthrough, reduced-motion proof`.
acceptance_criteria: docs/a11y/ contains AFTER screenshots + JSON for all five routes at BOTH 390x844 and 1280x900, every JSON noHorizontalScroll:true.

docs/a11y/AFTER.md states machine/browser, the per-route scroll table (all <= width), each canvas's aria-label, the reduced-motion wiring and what it damps (with motion returning when off), and how WS1/WS2/WS3 wins were verified preserved.
docs/a11y/KEYBOARD.md walks the keyboard path end-to-end per widget with visible focus and the WS3 clickable-prop keyboard equivalents.
Reduced-motion is demonstrated via emulated media (reduce vs no-preference) evidence under docs/a11y/.
No node_modules/, .next/, out/, or assets-src/ committed.
verification: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run build then re-run the harness; confirm all ten (5 routes x 2 widths) JSON reports show noHorizontalScroll:true.
Confirm docs/a11y/AFTER.md and docs/a11y/KEYBOARD.md exist and are populated with the required tables/walkthrough.
git status shows only docs/a11y + harness changes staged; no build output or node_modules.
findings:
DONE on branch a11y/mobile-accessibility (commit 7dc3620; NOT pushed, no PR per orchestrator). Verified all FEAT-002 code claims against source before writing docs (matchMedia lives ONLY in components/three/useReducedMotion.ts; asset() still wraps 38 wardrobe URLs; QualityToggle/quality.ts remain the single quality control; aria-labels and the 3 WardrobeBuilder focus-visible rings confirmed via git diff main + grep).

GATE (re-run this feature): `npm run lint` -> exactly one pre-existing @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx (0 errors, 0 other warnings); `npm run build` -> clean static export, all five routes prerendered.

SCROLL EVIDENCE: rebuilt then re-ran scripts/measure-viewports.mjs for all 5 routes at BOTH 390x844 and 1280x900 against built out/. All TEN JSON reports show scrollWidth==innerWidth (390/390 and 1280/1280) and noHorizontalScroll:true (docs/a11y/after-*-{390,1280}.json + per-route summary .json). Matches FEAT-001 finding that no route ever had document-level horizontal scroll; the 390 win was relieving cramping, not removing overflow.

HARNESS TWEAK: added three flags to scripts/measure-viewports.mjs (no new dependency, measure-load.mjs untouched): --reduced-motion <reduce|no-preference> (alias --emulate) calls page.emulateMedia({reducedMotion}) BEFORE navigating so the shared useReducedMotion() matchMedia hook reports that preference; --animations <disabled|allow> chooses the page.screenshot animations mode; --widths <csv> narrows the captured viewports. Each JSON now records reducedMotion + screenshotAnimations.

REDUCED-MOTION PROOF (docs/a11y/after-{landing,pet}-{reduced,motion}-1280.{png,json}, captured at 1280x900 with animations:'allow'): LANDING is the clear VISUAL proof -- the no-preference still captures the status ticker + 'CORE STACK & PLATFORMS' marquee MID-SCROLL, while the reduce still pins the same rails at their START position because the app/globals.css @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule collapses animation-duration to 0.001ms (neutralizing animate-scan/ticker/marquee/emberPulse/ringSpin/floatY); no content lost. PET documents the WebGL side honestly: both PNGs are single frozen frames so a static still cannot show per-frame ambient motion as a diff; the authoritative proof is that after-pet-reduced-1280.json records reducedMotion:'reduce', which flips the hook and GATES the JS motion -- cited exact gated paths (PetScene Pet useFrame early-return zeroing energy/action envelopes -> freezes breathing/bob/wiggle/droop + feed/play/sleep/clean hop; CameraRig pulse->0; DustMotes not rendered). This follows the orchestrator's honest-evidence guidance (Playwright freezes CSS animations for stills, so the WebGL diff is documented + attributed to emulateMedia rather than faked).

DOCS: docs/a11y/AFTER.md finalized -- machine/runtime (Node v22.23.2 via /opt/toolchains, Chromium via CHROME_PATH=/usr/local/bin/chrome playwright-core, headless swiftshader ANGLE, OPEN_INTERNET), gate expectation, per-route scroll table at BOTH widths (all <= width), each of the four canvas aria-labels, the reduced-motion wiring (shared hook + CSS @media) with exactly what it damps AND confirmation motion returns when off (hook reports false -> gates fall through, autoRotate re-enabled, byte-identical to pre-WS4), a NEW reduced-motion demonstration section, and the WS1/WS2/WS3 preservation with HOW verified. docs/a11y/KEYBOARD.md NEW -- per-widget end-to-end tab order (chef/coach: QualityToggle->mute->chips->composer->Send; pet: QualityToggle->Feed/Play/Sleep/Clean->name->Save; wardrobe: QualityToggle->option cards->swatches->custom colour->animation radios), visible focus-visible indicator, and the 3 WS3 clickable-prop keyboard equivalents (chef 'Suggest a recipe' chip, pet 'Play' button, wardrobe option cards -- all through the SAME handler). docs/a11y/DIFF.md NEW (optional) -- before-vs-after per route + full files-changed list.

COMMIT SCOPE: git add limited to scripts/measure-viewports.mjs + docs/a11y/ + this FEAT-003.json. Verified NOTHING under node_modules/.next/out/assets-src staged; deliberately left the unrelated untracked dirs (.agents/tasks/task-pet-motion-gallery, task-virtual-pet, one task-visual-lighting review .md) UNSTAGED -- they belong to other workstreams (same as FEAT-002).
